SELECT 
    s.state_name,
    prev.count AS prev_count,
    curr.count AS curr_count,
    prev.count - curr.count AS reduction
FROM
    states s
JOIN
    state_unit_granularity sg_prev ON s.state_id = sg_prev.state_id
JOIN
    state_unit_granularity sg_curr ON s.state_id = sg_curr.state_id
JOIN
    (SELECT 
        s.state_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS count 
     FROM 
        unit_assessments ua 
     JOIN 
        assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
     JOIN 
        districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
     JOIN 
        states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
     WHERE 
        ua.assessment_year = '2022-2023' 
        AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
     GROUP BY 
        s.state_id) prev ON s.state_id = prev.state_id
JOIN
    (SELECT 
        s.state_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS count 
     FROM 
        unit_assessments ua 
     JOIN 
        assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
     JOIN 
        districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
     JOIN 
        states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
     WHERE 
        ua.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
        AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
     GROUP BY 
        s.state_id) curr ON s.state_id = curr.state_id
WHERE
    sg_prev.unit_type = sg_curr.unit_type
    AND sg_prev.unit_type IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    reduction DESC
LIMIT 1
